interlinear.pinyin: bú huì bǎ hǎo dōng xi pián yi mài diào 。

不是自己职业的技能，一般很难学到。这些技能，对我很有用。.english: Skills outside one's own class are usually hard to learn. These skills are very useful to me.
不是自己职业的技能，一般很难学到。这些技能，对我很有用。.pinyin: bú shì zì jǐ zhí yè de jì néng ， yì bān hěn nán xué dào 。 zhè xiē jì néng ， duì wǒ hěn yǒu yòng 。

interlinear.pinyin: bú shì zì jǐ zhí yè de jì néng ，
yì bān hěn nán xué dào 。

第二个任务就有隐藏职业。我拒绝以后，还有四种有用的技能。.english: The second quest already offered a hidden class. After I refused, there were still four useful skills.
第二个任务就有隐藏职业。我拒绝以后，还有四种有用的技能。.pinyin: dì èr gè rèn wù jiù yǒu yǐn cáng zhí yè 。 wǒ jù jué yǐ hòu ， hái yǒu sì zhǒng yǒu yòng de jì néng 。

interlinear.pinyin: jiù yǒu yǐn cáng zhí yè 。

interlinear.gloss: there were still four useful skills.
interlinear.pinyin: hái yǒu sì zhǒng yǒu yòng de jì néng 。

这几个连着的任务，最后会有什么奖励？有好处，我可不能不要。.english: These connected quests, what reward will there be at the end? If there is something to gain, I cannot just pass it up.
这几个连着的任务，最后会有什么奖励？有好处，我可不能不要。.pinyin: zhè jǐ gè lián zhe de rèn wu ， zuì hòu huì yǒu shén me jiǎng lì ？ yǒu hǎo chù ， wǒ kě bù néng bú yào 。

interlinear.pinyin: zhè jǐ gè lián zhe de rèn wu ，

interlinear.gloss: what reward will there be at the end?
interlinear.pinyin: zuì hòu huì yǒu shén me jiǎng lì ？

interlinear.gloss: If there is something to gain,
I cannot just pass it up.
interlinear.pinyin: wǒ kě bù néng bú yào 。

可是，她等得到我学会那首歌吗？.english: But can she live to see me learn that song?
可是，她等得到我学会那首歌吗？.pinyin: kě shì ， tā děng de dào wǒ xué huì nà shǒu gē ma ？

interlinear.pinyin: wǒ xué huì nà shǒu gē ma ？
